steps.code:
# Parse the old_songs.txt content to extract song titles and artists.
old_songs_content = old_songs_file['content']
old_songs = []
for line in old_songs_content.strip().split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        # Format: "- Title by Artist1, Artist2"
        song_part = line[2:]
        if ' by ' in song_part:
            title, artists_str = song_part.split(' by ', 1)
            artists = [a.strip() for a in artists_str.split(',')]
            old_songs.append({'title': title.strip(), 'artists': artists})
print(old_songs)
